populations.label: All BC Public Service employees

populations.label: Employees assigned to Victoria offices
populations.sourceLabel: Data for BC Public Service employees whose office is located in Victoria
populations.scope: BC Public Service employees whose office is located in Victoria

notes: These statistics cover the BC Public Service, not the entire British Columbia public sector.
Victoria-office employees are included in the all-employees population. Do not add the two populations.
The release does not establish the calculation methods for Average HeadCount or Average Salary, or the start and end of each reporting period.
Year labels are preserved as printed. Calendar-year, fiscal-year and partial-year interpretations are unverified.
The 2019 Victoria Average HeadCount of 21,405 is reproduced as printed on pages 3 and 4. The release does not explain the increase or subsequent decrease.
Pages 2 and 4 repeat the values on pages 1 and 3. Each population and year is recorded once.
These aggregate observations are separate from named payment records and the fiscal-year FTE series. They must not be included in named-earner record counts, salary rankings or payment totals.
